title: ALiiCE: Evaluating Positional Fine-grained Citation Generation

model.params_source: paper Appendix A.2 (sampling temperature 0.5 for all models); max_tokens and top_p assumed

task.approximation: Table 7 elides documents after [3] with '...', so the same 'Documents [k] (Title: ...) text' line is assumed for k=4,5; ALCE's str_em normalisation re-implemented from its public definition; temperature-0.5 sampling adds run variance

items.source: princeton-nlp/ALCE-data (ALCE-data.tar, file asqa_eval_gtr_top100.json; mirror of the ALCE download_data.sh archive)
items.config_or_split: asqa_eval_gtr_top100.json (948 items, 100 docs each; the hook uses docs[0:5])
items.license: unknown (no license on the HF page; ALCE code repository is MIT; ASQA data carries its own terms)

fields_prose.documents: documents_block = five lines built by the hook from docs[0:5] (fields title, text; GTR top-100 order)
fields_prose.label: qa_pairs[*].short_answers (gold short answers for str_em; kept as the gold object)

local_files.archive: ALCE-data.tar (451,297,280 B; members: asqa_eval_gtr_top100.json 84.8 MB, asqa_eval_gtr_top100_reranked_oracle.json, asqa_eval_dpr_top100.json, eli5_*, qampari_*)

download.tool: urllib stream (over the runner's 250 MB _get limit, hence the hook reads the extracted file)

prompt.user_template:
Instruction: Please provide an accurate and concise answer that includes fine-grained in-text citations immediately following the relevant information. Place the citation numbers within brackets directly after the facts they support.
Citation format examples:
1. One of the most important areas is the automatic detection of vandalism[1][3] and data quality assessment in Wikipedia[2][4].
2. Cups can be made of glass[1] or plastic[2][3].Wikipedia's community has been described as cultlike[1], although not always with entirely negative connotations[2].
3. Wikipedia's community has been described as cultlike[1], although not always with entirely negative connotations[2].
Question: {question}
{documents}
Answer:
prompt.few_shot: none (the three citation-format examples are part of the fixed instruction)
prompt.verbatim: partial (instruction and citation examples copied verbatim including the missing space in 'plastic[2][3].Wikipedia'; document lines 4-5 reconstructed from the elided '...'; the trailing 'Answer:' cue precedes the model output in Table 7 and is kept as the prompt terminator)

placeholders_prose.question: items.question
placeholders_prose.documents: five lines 'Documents [k] (Title: {title}) {text}' for k=1..5 built from docs[0:5]

output.postprocess: strip; ALCE str_em: for each qa_pair check whether any gold short answer is an exact substring of the response after ALCE's normalize_answer (lowercase, remove punctuation and articles, collapse whitespace); item score = fraction of qa_pairs hit

metric.name: custom
metric.definition: exact-match recall (ALCE str_em): mean over the 948 questions of the share of gold short answers appearing verbatim in the response, times 100
metric.original_location: Table 1, ASQA block, row GPT-4 (5-psg), column Correct.

open_points: [triage 2026-09-18] A run with the released code's prompt format ('Document [k] Title: T: text', shorter instruction; DOC_LINE in the hook) would test the format hypothesis against the answer-style one: 907 calls, about USD 9; needs a go.

[variant 2026-09-19] Code-release prompt format (W4399912745v2, gpt-4-turbo-2024-04-09, all 948 items, temperature 0.5): 37.13 (CI 35.2-39.1) vs 37.60 with the Table 7 layout and the paper's 47.0; median reply 25 completion tokens under both prompts. The format hypothesis is rejected; the deviation sits with the short answers the pinned snapshot produced, and the successor gpt-5.6-sol (46.7, P3 vendor arm) matched the paper.
notes: Headline ALiiCE citation metrics (CVCP, citation recall/precision) need spaCy parsing and the TRUE T5-11B NLI model and are not re-run; only the correctness column is targeted. Input ~1K tokens (5 passages) and ~150 output tokens per call. || [datacheck 2026-09-18] Field names verified on the extracted file: question, docs[].{id,title,text,score,summary,extraction}, qa_pairs[].{context,question,short_answers,wikipage}, sample_id (948 unique), answer, annotations, wikipages; 100 docs per item (~100 words each); 2-6 qa_pairs per item. Hook harness/tierb/hooks/W4399912745.py builds documents_block and scores ALCE str_em (citations removed first, as in ALiiCE eval.py). Discrepancy for a human to note: the ALiiCE code release (github.com/ylXuu/ALiiCE, prompts/generation.json) renders passages as 'Document [k] Title: {title}: {text}' separated by blank lines and uses a shorter instruction with two citation examples, whereas the config keeps the paper's Table 7 text and the 'Documents [k] (Title: ...) ...' line format (DOC_LINE in the hook if the code format is preferred). || [triage 2026-09-18] PROTOCOL APPROXIMATION + BEHAVIOUR, no scoring defect; 37.60 unchanged (907 items, CI 35.5-39.6). (1) Cell: the 47.0 is Table 1 (Table 7 is the prompt), ASQA block, row GPT-4 (5-psg), column Correct. = exact match recall (caption; Sec. 4: 'ground truths are exact substrings of R', after Stelmakh et al.), std 0.4 over runs; 5-psg = top-5 GTR passages = docs[0:5], so the document count is the paper's setting. (2) Scorer verified: normalize_answer / remove_citations / exact_presence are the ALCE utils.py / eval.py functions line for line (lower -> strip string.punctuation -> drop a|an|the -> collapse whitespace; the same two citation regexes); ALCE's eval.py also truncates at the first newline, which only 4/907 outputs contain (37.44 with truncation); without citation removal the score would be 37.82 because bracket numbers such as '[15]' match numeric gold answers in 4 items, so removal is right; hook self-test passes. (3) Output: max_tokens 512, finish_reason stop 907/907, completion tokens mean 31 / median 25 / max 159, 0 empty, 8 without any citation, 18 hedging ('the documents do not mention ...'). (4) Prompt: Table 7 format kept; the released code's 'Document [k] Title: T: text' with a shorter instruction stays an undocumented alternative (DOC_LINE switch) that cannot be checked offline; 907/948 cost-cap subset and 1 seed at T=0.5 are in prepare.json. (5) Behaviour: 760/907 outputs are one sentence, 19.6 words on average (sd 14.4) vs the paper's GPT-4 length 28.1 (20.8); items cover 0 / 1 / 2 of their 2-6 gold sub-answers in 238 / 384 / 210 cases, str_hit 9.7; 56.4% of gold sub-answers occur in the 5 passages (ceiling 57.9) and the model recovers 59.4% of those. The 9.4 pp gap tracks the shorter single-interpretation answers of the pinned gpt-4-turbo-2024-04-09 (13 fingerprints); whether the prompt-format difference or the snapshot's answer style causes it cannot be separated offline. No re-analysis (nothing changed); result.json is the first pass.
